# SDL keyboard mapping

`linux_keymap.h` is derived from the official [SDL 3.4.18 source](https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL/blob/release-3.4.18/src/events/scancodes_linux.h), with unknown entries removed and pairs retaining Linux native key identifiers. The original zlib license notice is preserved in the header. The pinned source archive SHA256 is recorded in `cmake/OpenGLFrontend.cmake`. This table supports international, keypad and media keys alongside the existing profile mapping.
